name: B10-0121/2024 (The Left) – Urgent need to revise the Medical Devices Regulation
title: Urgent need to revise the medical devices regulation
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on the EU rules for medical devices, such as implants and diagnostic tests. It says patient safety must come first, and it regrets possible shortages, especially for children's care and rare-disease devices. It asks the European Commission to make the bodies that certify devices work more openly, predictably and affordably, and to finish setting up the EU database of medical devices on time.

- Nothing changes yet; Parliament only sets out its views and requests.
- Patients, device makers and the bodies that certify devices are affected.
- The Commission is asked to act; any law change comes later.
